name: Irradiance Vector Grid
definition: A volumetric data structure for caching low-frequency indirect illumination, designed for efficient storage and GPU rendering. It stores a fixed set of irradiance vectors in a 3D texture to capture geometric and photometric robustness against local variations of geometry and reflectance.
summary: The Irradiance Vector Grid caches indirect illumination in participating media using directional interpolation on a fixed grid to provide smooth, normal-aware lighting without Voronoi artifacts.
